scope: Next four shortest under-detailed canonical mechanics records after excluding Batches 396–400

records.name: Fighting Pose I
records.mechanics_notes: 0-Ki Power Up Super. After the pose animation, the user gains a Basic Movement Speed increase for 20 seconds; current skill-specific documentation identifies the effect as a movement-speed buff rather than a damage or defensive modifier. Exact speed multiplier and frame timing remain unresolved.

records.name: Fighting Pose B
records.mechanics_notes: 0-Ki Power Up Super. The pose grants a temporary Strike-move damage increase for 20 seconds. Current skill-specific documentation confirms the Strike-only scope and duration; exact percentage, stacking behavior, and frame timing remain unresolved.

records.name: Fighting Pose D
records.mechanics_notes: 0-Ki Power Up Super. The pose grants a temporary Boost Dash speed increase for 20 seconds. Current skill-specific documentation confirms the Boost Dash-specific scope and duration; exact multiplier and frame timing remain unresolved.

records.name: Android Rush
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super with a four-hit close-range sequence: three kicks followed by a backhand knockback. Directional control changes the final knockback route: neutral sends the opponent forward, up sends them downward, and down sends them upward. Current reference reports about 10% total damage; exact directional launch distances and frame data remain unresolved.

validation.evidence_policy: bounded; no unsupported probabilities, hidden prerequisites, frame data, or patch-independent balance claims
